midnight-violet.$description: Midnight Violet — Headings, body text, link text, and border accents — the signature ink color

deep-ink.$description: Deep Ink — Primary text, icon strokes, link color, and high-emphasis surface elements

cream-canvas.$description: Cream Canvas — Page background and elevated card surface — the warm white base layer

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Soft tinted card surface for content blocks and feature containers

mist-border.$description: Mist Border — Hairline borders, dividers, card edges, and structural separators

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text and muted surface details

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary shadow tint for layered elevation
